podcasts.title: Why Everyone Is Getting Excited About Personal AI Agents
podcasts.summary: Nathaniel Whittemore examines why consumer-facing personal agents are attracting more attention, using current products and market signals to ask what changed in practical delegation.
podcasts.why_useful: It provides a consumer-side complement to today’s Google CC story and helps separate excitement about agent categories from the concrete controls required for trustworthy delegation.
podcasts.connection: Pairs with the CC household-agent story by contrasting market enthusiasm with the design details—identity, permissions, memory, and execution—that determine whether a personal agent is usable.
podcasts.selection_rationale: Fresh registered-source episode inside the preferred 48-hour window; exact title, publication date, host, direct URL, and runtime were verified on Apple Podcasts.
podcasts.verification_note: Apple Podcasts lists September 17, 2026, Nathaniel Whittemore, and a 29:56 runtime.
podcasts.coverage_note: Primary 48-hour podcast window; one of two source-diverse selections.

podcasts.title: How to get discovered in AI search
podcasts.summary: Daniel Whitenack and Chris Benson talk with Liam Dunne and Ben Moore about how AI search changes discovery, retrieval, citations, query fan-out, and the transition toward agents that can act on discovered information.
podcasts.why_useful: The episode gives knowledge workers a practical mental model for how AI-mediated discovery differs from traditional search and why citations alone do not fully explain model answers.
podcasts.connection: It complements today’s workflow and agent stories by showing how retrieval and discovery become upstream inputs to systems that increasingly take action, not just return links.
podcasts.selection_rationale: Fresh registered-source episode inside the preferred 48-hour window from a second show; title, date, hosts, direct episode URL, and 55:14 runtime were verified on the publisher site.
podcasts.verification_note: Practical AI’s publisher page identifies episode E372, September 17, 2026, hosted by Daniel Whitenack and Chris Benson, runtime 55:14.
podcasts.coverage_note: Primary 48-hour podcast window; source-diverse from The AI Daily Brief.
